Beginning B1 Partner Visa Process for Non-Married Couples
Hi everyone ✨

We’re feeling a bit turned upside down after trying to start the visa process and would really appreciate any advice from the group 😌 (apologies, it is a long one 🫠)

I’m currently in Israel but flying to Ireland tomorrow until July. We had planned to open the file ASAP because we were told it helps with re-entry - but a lawyer told us that once the file is open, I can’t enter Israel as a tourist until I’m invited. Is that true?

We wanted to open the file in-person at the Hadera office (our friends said they did this in Afula) as we had some questions and missing docs, but were told everything must be done online. We then met a lawyer who walked straight in with our documents - do lawyers have a different process to open the file, or do they just submit online on your behalf?

Another issue is which office our file will be assigned to. We live in Tel Aviv, but my partner’s registered address is still his family home in Hof Carmel (which I understand is quite common). The lawyer said we need to change it to Tel Aviv or the file will be moved anyway and delayed. Has anyone applied with a different registered address successfully? Or has anyone used supporting documentation from their parent’s home instead of their temporary location elsewhere? I’ve heard horror stories about Tel Aviv waiting times and treatment there but the lawyer said there is little difference across the offices as everyone is busy now since the war. Does anyone have experience using a lawyer with a file based in Tel Aviv and feel that it actually sped up their process? We always planned to do it ourselves, but she made it sound very difficult without one.

Our main dilemma now:

1. Apply ASAP but risk being stuck away from my partner for very long 

Or 

2. Wait until July and apply upon return to Israel (as a tourist)

The instability of all the back and forth has been really hard and I’m struggling with the lack of routine and ability to work consistently. I’m worried that it’s going to be a while before I have this here and a break in Ireland to work might be better… We’re just trying to choose the most stable option 🥲

For those who have gone through this:

- How long did it take you to get your initial visa / work permission?

- How long did it take you to find a job after that?

- How did you manage financially and professionally in the meantime?

Any advice or experiences would mean a lot - thank you 🙏

Leah & Itai 🤍
